mechanism: Establish one dominant external threat, isolate a responsible actor through a dedicated preparation phase, make the decision legible through a visible calibration or commitment cue, execute exactly one decisive action, show its material consequence, then return to the responsible actor or outcome owner before a final lockup. The mechanism depends on causal proof, not on combat, weapons or destruction.

invariants.rule: Establish one dominant external threat or failure state before the actor commits.
invariants.purpose: Gives the sequence one legible problem.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without an opening threat, preparation becomes generic spectacle.

invariants.rule: Separate preparation from execution with one visible readiness action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate action removes the feeling of a deliberate decision.

invariants.rule: Insert one calibration, alignment or confirmation cue immediately before the decisive action.
invariants.purpose: Proves why the action occurs at that moment.
invariants.ablation_failure: A missing confirmation cue turns execution into an arbitrary cut.

invariants.rule: Execute one decisive action and show one directly attributable material consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple unrelated actions or an unseen result dissolve accountability.

invariants.rule: Return to the actor or outcome owner and hold a final lockup after the consequence.
invariants.purpose: Confirms who owns the result and closes the arc.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending only on the effect abandons the decision-maker and weakens closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source armored woman and shoulder launcher
the source ruined futuristic warzone and approaching aircraft
the source eye-targeting HUD and projectile-follow shot
the source aircraft fireball and burning skyline
the source SKYFALL title card and exact threat-preparation-launch-impact order

instantiations.concept: At an original alpine avalanche observatory, a glaciologist sees one unstable snow cornice above a research outpost, locks a resonant anchor into a marked ice plate, confirms one mechanical tension ring, releases a single low-frequency pulse and watches the cornice settle into a prepared catch basin before lowering the tool beside a wordless safety emblem.
